fields.label: Lead Cost Center
fields.description: Cost center that owns the client job (Events). External vendor costs and the gross Sales Invoice go here.

fields.label: Default Service Item
fields.description: Used on RFQs and Purchase Orders for cost lines that have no item.

fields.label: LTA Price List
fields.description: Buying price list with the fixed (LTA) prices. A price with a supplier wins over one without.

fields.label: Internal Charge Account
fields.description: Expense account debited on the lead cost center when a division's work is settled.

fields.label: Internal Income Account
fields.description: Income account credited on the division's cost center when its work is settled.

fields.label: Draft Workflow States
fields.description: One per line. While a Quotation or Sales Order is in one of these workflow states its plan is editable; any other unsubmitted state (pending, approved) locks it.

fields.label: Planner Columns
fields.description: Columns users can show in the cost plan. Leave empty for the standard set. Each user picks which of these they see.

fields.label: Budget Revision Approval
fields.description: After winning, a revision needs approval when any check triggers against the Agreed budget. 0 turns a check off.

fields.label: Line Threshold
fields.description: Client lines with an agreed cost at or above this are checked; a free extra at or above it needs approval

fields.label: Line Change %
fields.description: Change (up or down) on those lines that needs approval

fields.label: Job Change %
fields.description: Change of the job's total cost that needs approval

fields.label: Default Event Days
fields.description: Pre-fills Days on new lines when the plan has no Event days
